title: Quick Crunchy Ukrainian Vegetable Stew
description: A bitter, crunchy, and indulgent Ukrainian dish featuring Thai chilli jam, this stew is a unique blend of flavors and textures, reduced to perfection in a hot pot vessel, suitable for vegetarians.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the sliced carrots and cubed potatoes, cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the vegetable broth, Thai chilli jam, salt, and black pepper, stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
Serve the stew in bowls and enjoy the combination of bitter, crunchy, and indulgent flavors.
